distinction: fine, long, loose strands or thin pointers laid over a plain ground, against short, smooth, close-lying surface
positive: long silky or feathery hair (Afghan, silky terrier, Maltese, colobus, wool, hair slide), and clock faces with thin hands
negative: short sleek coats and blunt wrinkled heads (boxer, bull mastiff, pug, Doberman) plus glossy solid objects (piggy bank, revolver); it keeps out short smooth coat

distinction: open water surface with a body in it, against warm detailed objects on land
positive: submarine, whales, great white, coral reef, seashore, speedboat, snorkelers: blue-green water texture
negative: zebra, hourglass, rotisserie, phone box, langur: warm, tall, dry, fine detail

distinction: loose patterned cloth draped over a body
positive: sarong, poncho, fur coat, feather boa, tie, kimono, stole, maillot
negative: smooth hard white or pale objects: table lamp, Crock Pot, washbasin, nipple, mixing bowl

distinction: Straight slanted struts or lines rising to a point (rigging, cables, strings, poles), against furry or rounded animal bodies.
positive: Catamaran sails, suspension bridge cables, harp strings, tripod, mountain tent, maypole, crutch, steel arch bridge, police vans and minibuses (windowed boxy fronts), pelican bill.
negative: Furry animals and rounded domestic items: coyote, tabby, brown bear, Ibizan hound, printer, dishwasher, brown bear.

distinction: A dark dog with sharply separated tan and white markings, against light fawn or long-coated dogs.
positive: Entlebucher, toy terrier, Bernese, Rottweiler, black-and-tan, miniature pinscher, Doberman, Greater Swiss, bluetick, Cardigan; heat on the face markings and chest.
negative: Light fawn, red or long-coated dogs: Tibetan mastiff puppy, Shetland sheepdog, dhole, Welsh springer, golden retriever, collie, lesser panda, trimaran, monarch butterfly.

distinction: a dial or face with small regular marks (digits, ticks, spots) on a plain ground, versus a close furry face with one dark nose
positive: digital clock, wall clock, barometer, odometer, stopwatch, crossword, leopard, jaguar, tabby kitten, teddy bear, saltshaker with beads
negative: Chihuahua, Maltese, Pekinese, Yorkshire, meerkat, Cardigan face close up; grocery store tomatoes

distinction: The tip of a thin forward point on a body: a bird bill, or the round top of a thin pole (water tower, bell tower), against fluffy light dogs.
positive: Redshank, goose, little blue heron, limpkin, hummingbird, ostrich, albatross; also water tower, bell cote, bell tower, parking meter. Heat on the bill tip or the bulb at the top of the pole.
negative: Light fluffy dogs and smiling people: Tibetan terrier, golden retriever, Scottish deerhound, tricycle, tobacco shop, potter's wheel, thresher.

distinction: Patchy three-tone coat: black with white and rust patches, against a plain tan coat.
positive: Swiss mountain dogs (Entlebucher, Greater Swiss, Bernese, Appenzeller), Blenheim spaniel, bluetick, Rottweiler; 50% ring broccoli and cauliflower (dark green with white).
negative: Uniform fawn or tan short-coat dogs: bloodhound, Great Dane, bull mastiff, Rhodesian ridgeback, Ibizan hound; also Saint Bernard.

distinction: a thin curved line or chain of loops against a plain ground
positive: chain links, hummingbird, thunder snake, toucan with wire, necklace, corkscrew spiral, swing with chains, padlock chain, chainlink fence
negative: West Highland and Tibetan terrier faces, combination lock keypad, cassette, Siamese cat, car wheel: fluffy faces and dials

distinction: A dark coat with tan markings, as in s4b0:266 but a sharper version for smaller dogs and for birds with dark backs.
positive: Toy terrier, standard schnauzer, German shepherd, Cardigan, bluetick, Walker hound, Rottweiler, brambling, wallaby, basset, silky terrier.
negative: Not read (deep image not opened): colour is the key, gray keeps 0.41, invert 0.16.

distinction: Upright muzzle that projects from an animal head seen from the side, against a frontal or flat face.
positive: Dogs of every breed with a long muzzle (red wolf, Irish setter, borzoi, whippet, Cardigan); heat on the snout.
negative: Cat faces (tabby, schipperke), stork, screw, espresso cup, Ibizan hound lying: round flat faces or thin vertical things.

distinction: a white rolled tube or fold with a hole, held up on a wall
positive: paper towel, toilet tissue, golfcart, neck brace, seat belt, burrito, spider web
negative: domes, rosehip, digital clock, balloon: round wholes with a bright centre

distinction: vivid small body with thin legs or thin repeated weave pattern, versus dark or grey plain things
positive: indigo bunting, paintbrush weave, bee eater, black grouse, redshank, fly, ladybug, prairie chicken; weak peak 0.6
negative: Norfolk terrier, keyboard, giant schnauzer, cassette player, apron, pop bottles, digital watch: dark grey and cluttered

distinction: a dark nose tip on a pale muzzle
positive: schipperke, weasel, redbone, ice bear, grey fox, Appenzeller: heat on the nose
negative: fluffy collies, poodle, Norfolk terrier, dhole faces: face filled with fur

distinction: a soft-edged bright white plume rising from the ground or water against a darker or bluer backdrop
positive: geysers, fountains, fireboat spray, whale blow, waterfalls, breakwater splash, rocket exhaust
negative: round shiny rings and hubs (car wheel, carousel, pill bottle caps, ostrich head)

distinction: a thin pointed thing sticking out toward or from a face or beak, small and bright against a blurred green ground
positive: child with a pink lolly, child eating ice lolly, spoonbill and stork beak, go-kart, apiary, grasshopper, leafhopper, damselfly: a small bright narrow thing in the middle of a soft background
negative: junco, green mamba, hair slide, screws, Siamese cat, coral reef: a sharp small object centred on a plain or very busy ground. Not clean

distinction: long repeated parallel things receding in a row (rails, spoons in a rack, burner grates) against compact round natural bodies
positive: electric locomotives and rails in perspective, row of spatulas, steel drum, stove grate, barbershop: rows of hard-edged near-parallel bars
negative: round soft organic bodies on natural ground (rosehip, ladybug, crab, fish held by people, bikers)

distinction: a large bounded structure standing against sky
positive: castle, obelisk, dome, alp, container ship, aircraft carrier, barn, sports car
negative: people holding things, plunger, grocery store, cat

distinction: a single compact structure alone on an open horizon
positive: yurt, lighthouse, submarine, analog clock, thresher, pier, umbrella
negative: dog faces with pale muzzles

distinction: a white or pale soft coat, against warm reddish-brown fur
positive: white poodle, Samoyed, goose, white stork, cockatoo, Old English sheepdog, guinea pig, kuvasz, plush toy
negative: tawny, tiger, red fox, dhole, bloodhound, Irish setter, Pekinese: warm orange-brown fur; and an orange-and-black salamander

distinction: The bill tip of a long-billed bird against a plain, flat ground, against frontal dog faces.
positive: European gallinule, redshank, ruddy turnstone, coucal, drake, egret, little blue heron, hummingbird, bee eater, hartebeest horn, robin; heat on the bill.
negative: Frontal dog faces: Italian greyhound, Irish setter, Lakeland terrier, basset, Chihuahua; jersey, lab coat, hoopskirt.

distinction: A small perched bird with a bright warm or yellow breast against a dark or grey back and a bare, thin-branched background.
positive: House finch, goldfinch, indigo bunting, brambling, chickadee, junco; heat on the breast.
negative: Big dogs lying down (briard, German shepherd, bloodhound), car wheel, dome, bikini: large, round, or flat-lit.

distinction: a pale or white soft-looking body, against brown or dark-spotted coat
positive: white fluffy dogs (Maltese, Samoyed, komondor, Bedlington), cockatoo, flamingo, spoonbill, soccer ball, airship, mop
negative: brown and tawny coats and patterned prey (Border terrier, malinois, jackfruit, warthog, ruddy turnstone, butterfly)

distinction: A close-fitting cover on a body part (a cap, bra, helmet, veil), against wheels and domes.
positive: Shower cap, bonnet, crash helmet, brassiere, bikini, abaya, miniskirt, fur coat, cassette, sunglasses, overskirt, ferret on hand.
negative: Wheels and domes: mountain bike, cab, jinrikisha, dome (stained glass, Les Invalides), moped, oxcart; chiffonier, Old English sheepdog.

distinction: a big, heavy, broad-headed animal mass seen close and face-on or resting, versus thin slender things
positive: Rottweiler, cougar, lynx, tabby, English setter, Newfoundland, tusker, pug in a suit, bison: round heavy bodies and faces with eyes; mass not legs
negative: toy terrier, Ibizan hound, oystercatcher, cockroach, black and white stork, red panda: thin legs, pointed beaks and snouts. It is the mirror of s4b1:9

distinction: a smooth, soft-eared dog head, against a radial symmetric or pointed form
positive: floppy-eared dogs with a plain face (retrievers, beagle, redbone, foxhound), at the head
negative: radial or domed symmetry (umbrella ribs, dome, electric fan, vault) and pointed fox or terrier faces

distinction: a dark glossy compact body
positive: indigo bunting, peacock, stork, lipstick, screwdriver, barbell
negative: unread

distinction: Bumpy, knobbly mass made of many small rounded lobes in green: a texture, not an object, and orientation does not matter.
positive: Broccoli (florets in a bowl, close-ups, white backgrounds), cauliflower, rice-and-shrimp bowl, hay roll, Angora fluff, volcano plume, lemon pile, spider on a leaf, planetarium dome.
negative: Sparse lone animals on bare rock (grey fox, bighorn, ibex, impala), rotisserie rows, piano keys, monitors: smooth or sparse, spaced-out items.

distinction: a single compact structure alone on an open horizon
positive: yurt, lighthouse, submarine, analog clock, thresher, pier, umbrella
negative: dog faces with pale muzzles

distinction: a dog head in side view with drooping ears (heat is on the ear), versus fluffy upright-eared or small pointed faces
positive: beagle, redbone, Appenzeller, kuvasz, Labrador, Weimaraner, bloodhound, Rhodesian ridgeback, Walker hound
negative: lesser panda, groenendael, Persian cat, papillon, house finch, Lhasa, Yorkshire terrier, keeshond: upright ears and fluffy rounded faces

distinction: a vessel body with a loop handle on its side
positive: pitcher, cup, coffeepot, mug, teapot, cocktail shaker with cup (probe: handle 0.28, no handle 0.01)
negative: radial spokes and studs seen face-on: bolo tie, car wheel, umbrella, saltshaker, jinrikisha wheel

distinction: one large smooth mass in an open field
positive: soccer ball, tent, valley, alp, volcano, washbasin, airliner, sports car
negative: radial fans, fine fur faces and wheels (car wheel, daisy)

distinction: a big plain-coloured face of an object versus small repeated buttons and mechanical detail
positive: whistle, safe, apron, mortar, carton, tray, mosquito net, nail, screws, sleeping bag
negative: scale with keypad, combination lock, phone keypad, typewriter keys, cannon, reel, magnetic compass, Border collie face: grids of small buttons or fine mechanism. It keeps out small-part detail

distinction: a lean pointed face of a whole animal seen from the side
positive: dingo, EntleBucher, basset, Saluki, Siberian husky, Ibizan hound, beagle, coyote; heat on the face
negative: close-ups of short flat or bearded faces: Norfolk terrier, Shih-Tzu, Tibetan terrier, cardoon thistle, fig

distinction: A dense array of tiny parallel keys, buttons or whiskers around a small mouth, against radial wheel shapes.
positive: Hyena and small dogs lying down (Border terrier, Pembroke, Blenheim spaniel, Norfolk terrier), phone keypad, harmonica, sax, abacus, grille, dial telephone, accordion keys, lipstick.
negative: Radial or circular: umbrella, Crock Pot, wall clocks, analog clock, dome, kimono, barometer, pool table, television.

distinction: separate dark spots across a coat or surface, versus a plain shaggy face
positive: English setter, German short-haired pointer, dalmatian, Great Dane merle, hyena, leopard, banded gecko, digital clock, analog gauges
negative: Yorkshire and Norfolk terrier faces, daisy, golden retriever, collie, red-breasted merganser: smooth or fluffy single-tone close faces

distinction: A dark coat with tan and white markings in a fixed pattern, against pale or white shapes.
positive: Entlebucher, Appenzeller, Doberman, Gordon setter, Rottweiler, toy terrier, black-and-tan, miniature pinscher, Tibetan mastiff, guenon; heat on face and chest.
negative: White or bright objects: parachute, microphone, airliner, kuvasz (white dog), titi, hen, planetarium, safe, diaper.

distinction: a pale, cream or white body, against warm dark-brown coat
positive: polar bear, white or cream dogs, cockatoo, egret, white Tibetan terrier, pale gibbon
negative: dark brown and chocolate coats (Weimaraner, Labrador, Chesapeake, schipperke) and also an orange and a black-footed ferret: a rich dark warm colour

distinction: A broad dial (on for 97% of photos, mean 3.35) that rises when one smooth, large, low-texture region sits against a calm background (water, bedspread, studio surface) and falls to negative on small, sharp, saturated warm-coloured items on cluttered ground.
positive: Peak photos: quilt on a bed, projector, speedboat and its wake, bird over open water, alligator on a log, shark and dugong under water. Heat maps sit on the smooth surface or the water, not on one object.
negative: Barn, red plunger, cello, baseball, whistle, hamster: compact, warm or red, hard-edged things.

distinction: a coat or surface made of many separate dark spots on a lighter ground, versus a plain single-colour surface
positive: German short-haired pointer, dalmatian, Great Dane (merle), English setter, bluetick, snow leopard, leopard, horned viper, sidewinder, custard apple
negative: coil, Rhodesian ridgeback, Chesapeake Bay, vizsla, eggnog, ice bear: smooth plain brown or cream

distinction: a horizontal band at the base of a scene: a waterline, floor or reflection line under an upright object
positive: boathouse on water, planetarium reflected, dock, egret, grocery aisle, mosque, obelisk, whistle; the heat is at the bottom edge
negative: dark standing dogs on grass: American Staffordshire, groenendael, keeshond, German shepherd, Great Pyrenees

distinction: thin straight pointers on a plain round face
positive: analog and wall clocks, stopwatch, compass, barometer dial; drawn clock hands on a white disc fire it at 0.42, a bare disc 0.05
negative: vehicles and pens (fire engine, police van, fountain pen, water buffalo): thick coloured bulk

distinction: A long thin curving neck or tube carrying a small head, against a compact furry body.
positive: American egret, ostrich, little blue heron, pelican, flamingo, bustard, white stork (heat on the neck and head); 50% ring barracouta, snakes, nematode, sturgeon.
negative: Dogs sitting or lying with compact bodies: basenji, Boston bull, German shepherd, Ibizan hound, bluetick, Saint Bernard; border collie face.

distinction: bare warm skin tone or tan coat
positive: swimming trunk, bikini, volleyball, butcher shop, basset, proboscis monkey, bloodhound, Rhodesian ridgeback; heat on skin
negative: muzzle, dial telephone, ladle, compass, bee, spider, minibus, lawn mower: metal or white objects

distinction: A smooth domed or arched shell with an arc of spray or curve, against thin spoked or wheeled shapes.
positive: Fireboat jets (water arcs), radio telescope dish, planetarium dome, armadillo shell, iron (smooth shell), fountain, mountain tent, tench body, bonnet, chain mail, knee pad. Heat on the dome or arc.
negative: Water ouzel (small dark bird with a white bib, on the bank), cannon wheels, analog clock, folding chair, plaque, cock, pop bottle, worm fence: spokes, rings, thin crossed bars.

distinction: a white smooth rounded body, against radial or hard-edged metallic form
positive: giant panda face, black stork, piggy bank, toaster, soccer ball, Shih-Tzu, Maltese
negative: dome, rickshaw wheel, car wheel, cannon, green snake, Siamese cat: spoked or tubular dark-and-light structure
